content:
leo: Heads-up: embedding p99 for tiny payloads spiked during the 10:00 load test. These are 1-item requests, dims=1536.

jin: Are they going through splitter or tiny fastpath?

leo: splitter, no shape hint. traces show `batch_wait_ms` ~80ms.

pat: could we add a light heuristic: if count==1 && dims<=2048 && node.queue<3 -> prefill-fastpath. Opt-in via `X-Embed-Mode: prefill` header.

sre-oncall: accounting/telemetry needs: `prefill_fastpath_rate`, `prefill_unit_delta_pct`, `prefill_rejects`. Alert if unit delta > 12% for 20m.

jin: Router pseudo:
```
if (hdr=="prefill" || (count==1 && dims<=2048 && queue<3)) route=PREFILL_FASTPATH; else route=SPLITTER;
```

pat: also emit `router_decision` tag and `batch_fill_time_ms` in spans so we can prove reduced wait vs exec.

console-bot: feature-flag deploy `embeds.prefill_fastpath` -> canary 5% -> will post metrics.

sre-oncall: i'll add alerts and a Grafana panel for `prefill_unit_delta_pct` and p99 latency split by route.

leo: UX ask: console should surface per-tenant unit-delta and allow filtering tenants where delta > 5% for easier RM follow-up.

jin: agreed. action items: pat -> router change + tags, jin -> SDK header docs, sre-oncall -> metrics/alerts, leo -> console filter mock. reconvene after canary metrics land. :thumbsup:
